UI state machine

Disabled → DevelopmentVerbose → ProductionMinimal → DegradedSink → RedactedExport

WBP_Diagnostics observes results from URPGTelemetryAdapter. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_TelemetryPolicy_Default. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
CorrelationId and CommandId: shared across client request, zone handler and backend receipt
EventName/SchemaVersion: stable allowlisted telemetry keys
OutcomeCode/DurationMs/RetryCount: numeric or controlled vocabulary
SourceSinkCurrencyDelta and ItemDefinitionId: accounting classifications; ledger remains canonical
PrivacyClass: Operational|Economic|ModerationRestricted
SamplingRate: 0..1 for high-volume noncritical metrics; no sampling of required ledger receipts

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGTelemetryAdapterImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_DiagnosticsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RecordCommandOutcome(Context, ResultCode, DurationMs) -> Queued|SinkUnavailable; nonblocking metrics
QueryOwnCommandStatus(CommandId) -> Pending|Receipt|Unknown; backend authenticated read
ExportSupportDiagnostics(Consent, RedactionPolicy) -> RedactedBundle|Declined

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Attach one correlation ID when an interaction begins and propagate it through the owned RPC and backend command.
  2. Commit the economic receipt and audit delta in the durable transaction; telemetry emission occurs after commit and can retry through the documented outbox without regranting.
  3. UI shows Pending, Accepted or a friendly localized reason; diagnostics show the stable command ID for support.
  4. Dashboards aggregate currency sources/sinks, item generation/destruction, rejection rates, gather yields and merchant stock pressure.
  5. A metric sink outage does not block a valid committed transaction; required audit persistence failure does block a transaction whose policy requires it.
  6. Support exports remove access tokens, private chat and machine secrets and identify build/catalog version before user approval.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Author a controlled error catalog in DA_TelemetryPolicy_Default and map codes to localization keys rather than exposing backend stack traces.
  2. Reopen merchant, gathering, fishing and crafting handlers to record the same command/receipt IDs in their result events.
  3. Build WBP_Diagnostics as a development-only screen with read-only epoch/revision/command state; never add buttons that directly set currency on production clients.
  4. Create a synthetic purchase sequence from 1000 to 950 currency, a sell/buyback and a failed full-bag craft. Compare ledger changes to dashboard events.
  5. Document retention/access and a minimal support report format: build, zone, approximate time, command ID, observed and expected behavior.

Reopen Phase11 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / purchase-craft-gather receipt fixtures. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Metric sink down -> transaction receipt still durable, UI confirms from authority.
Duplicate receipt delivery -> dashboard de-duplicates by receipt/event ID; no second economic grant.
Unknown error code -> generic safe message plus correlation ID, not a credential-containing exception.
Support bundle review -> tokens and service credentials absent.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Development logs may retain detailed command metadata; production sampling/retention are deployment decisions. No commercial analytics service is required to start.

Use structured event keys and bounded labels; never label a metric with arbitrary player chat or unbounded item instance UUIDs. Audit access to sensitive records.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
